maddeler.e:
اختلبوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَبُوا (iḵtalabū) /ix.ta.la.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# اُخْتُلِبُوا (uḵtulibū) /ux.tu.li.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# اِخْتَلِبُوا (iḵtalibū) /ix.ta.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
